warnings.headline: Rain warning
warnings.description: During the warning period, widespread rainfall accumulations between 25 and 40 l/m² are expected. Locally, totals may reach 50 l/m² in the extreme west and southwest of the country.

warnings.headline: Yellow warning for wind in Belgium - Liège
warnings.description: There is a strong wind expected with wind gusts between 80 and 100 km/h (70 and 90 km/h with leafed trees). Be careful.
warnings.instruction: Be vigilant

warnings.headline: Yellow warning for rain in Belgium - Namur
warnings.description: A lot of rain is expected: 10 to 30 l/m² in 1 hour, or 20 to 40 l/m² in 6 hours, or 25 to 50 l/m² in 24 hours. Be careful.
warnings.instruction: Be vigilant

warnings.headline: Orange warning for rain in Belgium - Luxembourg
warnings.description: Extensive rainfall is expected in several places: 31 to 50 l/m² in 1 hour, or 41 to 60 l/m² in 6 hours, or 51 to 100 l/m² in 24 hours. Be careful and follow the instructions of the responsible authority.
warnings.instruction: Be prepared and follow advice

warnings.instruction:

Recommendations for what to do: 
Adapt your behaviour in road traffic. Avoid flooded areas.

warnings.headline: Official WARNING of STORM-FORCE GUSTS
warnings.description:
There is a risk of storm-force gusts (level 2 of 4).
Height range: > 1500 m; Max. gusts: < 100 km/h; Wind direction: south then south-west; Increased gusts: in exposed locations ~ 110 km/h
warnings.instruction:
Hazard(s) caused by: single falling trees; objects falling to the ground. 
Recommendations for what to do: 
Secure scaffolding and free-standing objects (e.g. screens and platforms/stages). For example, fasten tents and coverings or, if there is enough time, take them down completely. Watch out for falling objects (e.g. large branches, roof tiles) and seek shelter if possible.

warnings.instruction:

Recommendations for what to do: 
Secure loose objects. For example, fasten tents and coverings.

- Main wind direction west to southwest
